newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Santa Isabel signs Marmentini deal.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Santa Isabel signs Marmentini deal.

text.p: Chilean supermarket chain Santa Isabel said it signed a deal to buy financially troubled supermarket firm Marmentini after Marmentini reached deals with creditors.
Santa Isabel, Chile's largest supermarket chain, will pay $19.5 million for 10 Marmentini stores throughout the country, said the company in a statement to the Securities Superintendency.
The deal, which was announced in July, had depended on Marmentini reaching a pact to repay debts owed to creditors.
Valparaiso-based Santa Isabel already operates 58 stores in Chile, 11 in Peru and three in Paraguay.
